opening_title: Since 8.2.0, automatic multiprocessing causes race conditions in my project

expected_outcome.rationale: The opening attributes six child processes and resource races to pytest 8.2.0 without code, package list or OS version. Conservatively exclude this possible family member from training with 12263/12273, without calling it a confirmed duplicate.
